snippet.title: Perils in Paradise Announcement | Hearthstone
snippet.description:
Book your trip, pack your bags, and board your flight to the Spiral Isles! Hearthstone's premiere vacation destination opens July 23rd.

Join the team as they reveal new cards on their island getaway to Perils in Paradise - Hearthstone’s next 145-card expansion, featuring class-hopping Tourists, re-opening Locations, tasty Drinks, and more!

Pre-Purchase Perils in Paradise Mega Bundle: https://blizz.ly/4cgayn2
Learn more about Perils in Paradise: https://blizz.ly/4clC0Qi
Perils in Paradise Card Library: https://blizz.ly/3KHQMoU

hearthstone.blizzard.com
